title: Myriad Codex
text: The framework's third evolution progressively rewrites one continuous world: establishment, matter, form, time, life and authorship. The last step consumes a Guide Book, Crystal Pedestal and Mana Engine. See this entry's recipe pages, the framework hints or JEI for the six stages.

Only the rear inlet accepts 8192–16384 MPU or equivalent FE/second. Kinetic input requires at least 16 RPM and provides 32 x |RPM| SU; it must still reach 8192 to start. Diameter starts at 7 and increases by 2 per complete additional 2048, up to 15. Power loss blocks taking the heart or starting, but accepted edits finish independently.
Take and place the Heart of Myriad to select a center, then use the codex to configure it. The heart entry covers placement and recall; related mode entries cover materials and affected positions.

Place the heart before executing. Specimens must have empty inventories, tanks and inserted contents. Choose a mode, insert specimens as needed, then Unfold. Success recalls the heart, consumes specimens and closes the book without saving a formula. Interaction is blocked while edits spread outward from the center.
Edits are permanent and need no continuing power. Overwritten machines, containers and even the source codex are erased without refunds. No mode can create a codex or temporary heart.
The codex can also transform a final-stage Guidance Orb into Universal Understanding without being consumed. See the related entry for mana restoration and dismantling.
